question_stem: A car of mass $1400\text{ kg}$ is towing a trailer of mass $500\text{ kg}$ down a straight hill inclined at an angle of $5^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. The car and trailer are connected by a light rigid tow-bar. At the top of the hill the speed of the car and trailer is $20 \text{ m s}^{-1}$ and at the bottom of the hill their speed is $30 \text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
It is given that as the car and trailer descend the hill, the engine of the car does $150\,000\text{ J}$ of work, and there are no resistance forces.

Find the length of the hill.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
It is given instead that there is a resistance force of $100\text{ N}$ on the trailer, the length of the hill is $200\text{ m}$, and the acceleration of the car and trailer is constant.

Find the tension in the tow-bar between the car and trailer.
